description.value:
Frequency once per week

Fast without food, water, or rest for a full day. At the end you are drained 2 and your maximum Hit Points are halved until you next make daily preparations. Your next Miracle or Unmaking, taken within 24 hours, succeeds automatically and at the maximum effect its tier allows, with no negotiation about degree. If you do not use it within 24 hours, the cost stands and the benefit is lost.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 3, plus STRUCT-EFFECT-COMPANION: structurally identical to the-long-fast/the-long-fast-effect (which does have a companion) but has no companion of its own. If built, the debuff half would look like {key: ActiveEffectLike, mode: multiply, path: system.attributes.hp.max, value: 0.5} (multiply confirmed a real mode at pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/ae-like.ts:122-206); drained 2 is a standard condition applied once, not via a rule element. The 'next Miracle auto-succeeds at max' clause is pure GM narrative with no number to encode.
